scope: Read-only workbook and input-reader comparison. No source replacement, formula evaluation or scientific pipeline rerun.

method.xlsx: Compare every explicit cell by worksheet name and coordinate, resolving shared/inline strings and numeric lexical equivalents; distinguish blank, text, number, boolean and errors. Compare formula XML and cached values separately, with no recalculation.
method.xls: Compare every parsed worksheet cell with xlrd; compare complete OLE streams and align all BIFF records. Identify metadata-only WRITEACCESS and compound-file directory changes.
method.fields: Read all five declared tables twice, using the source-preservation and evidence-inference options. Compare dimensions, row/column order, column types and typed values at every position, without sorting, tolerance, trimming or missing-to-zero conversion.
method.styles: Compare resolved cell-style components; inspect changed workbook/view/layout metadata, comment bodies, custom XML payloads and embedded image pixels separately.
method.impact: Trace the existing declarations/readers and retain input-byte validation requirements. Numerical non-impact is an inference from identical read inputs and unchanged code, not a replacement-run result.
method.field_roles: All parsed columns were compared, including fields with no selected mapping; an empty role list is not a claim that a value never appears in retained source-row evidence.
